versionGroups.label: Internal @web-ui-poc/* packages are de-workspaced: consumed via file: relative paths (local specifiers, not semver), so syncpack ignores them.

semverGroups.label: arktype + its JSON-schema helper are pinned to exact versions (runtime validator: patch-level drift is a wire-contract risk)
Biome is pinned to a tilde range so a minor bump can't silently change lint/format output across the team
Everything else uses caret ranges (repo default)
